title: Hydroxyapatite/urea hybrid materials: what is the basis for the enhanced nutrient efficiency?
content:
Environ. Sci.: Adv., 2025, 4,77-89
DOI: 10.1039/D4VA00197D, Critical Review
Open Access

Mohamed Ammar, Sherif Ashraf, Jonas Baltrusaitis
Urea molecules are reacted with the surface of hydroxyapatite crystals to create a moderate bonding strength system, which hinder the release of N and P into the soil and support the thermal stability.
